opus.problem: Isaiah 7:12 only records Ahaz refusing to ask. The command to ask for a sign (7:10-11) and the promise of a son with this name (7:14) are not in the cited verse, so the clue is not true to its reference. The promise part also repeats clue 2.
Assyria and the Euphrates floodwaters come from Isaiah 8:7, not the cited 8:8. Isaiah 8:8 mentions neither, so the clue's main picture is not supported by its reference.

Matthew 1:22 does not mention the angel, Joseph's dream (1:20) or this name (1:23). It only says the events fulfilled the prophet's words. The clue is not true to its verse. Its fact, that the prophecy of this name was fulfilled at Jesus' birth, nearly repeats clue 6 and clue 2.
